Name: Till Grass In Farms
Author: Hello1423
Description:
This allows you to grow crops even on the permanent grass tiles of your farm!


To install just throw the files within the Till Grass folder into your \Stardew Valley\Content\Maps folder

Downloads.Description: Move everything from Till Grass folder to Maps folder in Content

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
